_source.grounding: An MCP client calls a tool over streamable HTTP on loopback inside an SDK span 'client.call'; the server's tool handler opens withToolSpan('server.add'). The JS MCP SDK emits no spans of its own; the instrumentation carries the trace context in the request, so the handler's span joins the client's trace (without it the two are separate traces).

_gaps: The JS MCP SDK (unlike mcp 2.x for Python) emits no tools/call or tools/list spans; only the context propagation is the instrumentation's.
